rawContent: @Freeyourmindkid Like Lester N'Em praising select abolitionists, but calling the aims of the Civil Rights Era immoral, unnatural, and unacceptable.  And today, like every conservative who selectively quotes MLK and praises the non-violence strategy, but decries #BLM as too radical and too much.

I often wonder how many other cishet dudes got a crash course in abuse dynamics from the sidelines of #MeToo . Not just sexual assault. Day-to-day awfulness in various interactions with women, especially intimate ones. Most didn't make those connections, but some did.
